description: Checks Power Apps canvas YAML before the user pastes it into Studio: YAML syntax (tabs, duplicate keys, ': ' and '#' traps), structure (list of '- Name:' controls with Control/Variant/Properties/Children, or pa.yaml with App/Screens/ComponentDefinitions, or Themes), Control type@version format, properties starting with '=', duplicate control names, version conflicts, known control types, component custom properties and theme fields. Rules mirror the official pa.schema.yaml v3.0 (microsoft/PowerApps-Tooling). Returns errors and warnings with line numbers. Call it on every YAML you generate. Max 40000 characters. It cannot see the user's app: data sources, screen names and exact property lists are checked by Studio on paste.

kind.description: controls = Paste code list, source = *.pa.yaml file, theme = Paste theme

name: validate_yaml
title: Validate Power Apps canvas YAML
